newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline buffeted by U.S, shipping still tight.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline buffeted by U.S, shipping still tight.

text.p: NWE gasoline faced a bumpy ride on Tuesday, buffeted by weaker NYMEX gasoline which recovered as the day progressed as traders covered shorts from early profit taking.
U.S. demand remains the focus of attention since European interest was still muted.
Eurograde barges were traded between $218.50 a tonne and $222 and Feb swaps were done twice at $223.75.
Taking product to meet U.S. interest was still being hit by a lack of tankers.
"You have to find a ship before a cargo," said one trader, who saw freight at $18 a tonne.
Market bears pointed to a U.S. stock build which could undermine continued price gains for European gasoline.
